headline: Chip-led selloff, day two
summary: The Nikkei ended the morning at 58,957 (−1.18%) after Monday's −2.42%. New US export limits on advanced AI chips landed on top of the Nvidia CEO shock. The damage sits in high-priced semiconductor names, while retail, services and pharma are holding up. Nvidia reports before Wednesday's Tokyo open.

macro.label: Nikkei 225
macro.read: Second day down and under 59,000 for the first time since 9 Nov. The record close was 72,354 on 22 June.

macro.label: TOPIX, Monday
macro.read: The broad market fell far less than the Nikkei. The hit is concentrated in a few high-priced chip stocks.

macro.label: USD/JPY
macro.read: Pinned just under 160. The finance minister has warned on one-sided moves, so intervention risk caps the upside.

macro.label: JGB 10-year
macro.read: Close to the top of the year's range (52-week high 3.12%). Higher yields add pressure on growth stocks.

macro.label: BoJ policy rate
macro.read: Next decision Fri 18 Dec. A move to 1.50% is the market's base case.

macro.label: US 10-year
macro.read: Markets price a Fed hike on 9 Dec, with talk of 50bp.

macro.label: Nasdaq
macro.read: Export curbs and Nvidia weighed on tech. The Dow lost 739 to 51,608 as banks sold off too.

macro.label: Japan Q3 GDP
macro.read: Weak household spending and a drag from net exports, with capex firm. Second estimate 8 Dec.

themes.title: AI and semiconductor de-rating
themes.body: Nvidia's CEO exit and new US limits on exporting advanced AI chips are hitting the stocks that carry the Nikkei. Advantest and Tokyo Electron together took roughly 1,070 yen off the index on Monday. The question for Wednesday is whether Nvidia's guidance resets data-centre spending expectations.

themes.title: BoJ normalisation
themes.body: Policy rate 1.25%, a December hike about 84% priced, and the 10-year JGB near 2.9%. Hawkish board members argue the neutral rate is higher than markets assume. Supportive for banks, harder for long-duration growth.

themes.title: Fed re-tightening
themes.body: Sticky US inflation has markets pricing a December hike, possibly 50bp, with the US 10-year around 5.1%. This fed directly into last week's selling in AI names.

themes.title: Yen at 160 and intervention risk
themes.body: USD/JPY sits just under 160 with the Ministry of Finance warning on one-sided moves. A weak yen helps exporters' earnings but feeds import inflation and raises the BoJ's urgency. The monthly intervention total is due around 30 Nov.

themes.title: Rotation into domestic demand
themes.body: Money leaving semiconductors is going to retail, services, pharma and other defensives. Nitori and consumer names were strong on Monday, and Japanese earnings are still described as solid.

themes.title: Japan growth stall
themes.body: Q3 GDP came in flat to slightly negative. Consumption is weak and net exports dragged, while capex held up. So far this is not seen stopping the BoJ.

catalysts.title: Japan Q3 GDP, first estimate
catalysts.outcome: Flat to slightly negative (about −0.1% annualised). Consumption weak, capex firm.

catalysts.title: Nvidia CEO exit hits Tokyo chip stocks
catalysts.watch: First Tokyo session after the US sold AI names on the Jensen Huang reports.
catalysts.outcome: Nikkei −1,480 (−2.42%) to 59,662. Advantest −11%, worth about 730 yen of the fall.

catalysts.title: US tightens export limits on advanced AI chips
catalysts.watch: Commerce Department announcement. Read-through to data-centre demand and Japanese chip equipment makers.
catalysts.outcome: Dow −739, Nasdaq −627. Nikkei −1.18% at the morning close after falling as much as 970 yen.

catalysts.title: Nvidia quarterly results
catalysts.watch: Data-centre demand and guidance. First numbers since the CEO change and the new export rules. Sets the tone for Advantest, Tokyo Electron and Lasertec at the open.

catalysts.title: Japan trade balance, October
catalysts.watch: Forecast deficit about ¥956bn against ¥537bn in September. Watch the energy import bill under a weak yen.

catalysts.title: FOMC minutes
catalysts.watch: How strong the case was for a larger December hike.

catalysts.title: Anthropic IPO
catalysts.watch: A test of appetite for AI equity while AI names are under pressure.

catalysts.title: US, China and Russia leaders' summit
catalysts.watch: Any signal on chip export controls and trade.

catalysts.title: Japan national CPI, October
catalysts.watch: Previous 2.1%. Forecasts range from 2.0% to 2.6% depending on how much energy and the weak yen feed through. One of the last inflation prints before the BoJ.

catalysts.title: MoF monthly intervention total
catalysts.watch: Shows whether Tokyo stepped in as USD/JPY approached 160. Date is approximate.

catalysts.title: Japan Q3 GDP, second estimate
catalysts.watch: Capex revisions are the usual swing factor.

catalysts.title: FOMC decision (8–9 Dec meeting)
catalysts.watch: A hike is fully priced. The debate is 25bp or 50bp, and what it does to US yields and USD/JPY.

catalysts.title: US CPI, November
catalysts.watch: First inflation print after the Fed decision.

catalysts.title: BoJ decision (17–18 Dec meeting)
catalysts.watch: About 84% priced for a move from 1.25% to 1.50%. Governor's press conference at 15:30.
